cohort: Nulliparous women who underwent Kiwi omnicup vacuum delivery between 2010 and 2015.
finding: The performance of a mediolateral episiotomy was associated with a decreased risk of severe perineal tears, vaginal tears, and labial trauma in nulliparous women undergoing Kiwi omnicup vacuum deliveries.
mod_finding: Mediolateral episiotomy was associated with a significantly lower rate of severe perineal trauma, vaginal tears, and labial trauma during Kiwi omnicup vacuum deliveries.
